hero.title: Building tomorrow's infrastructure.
hero.description: Stadiums, hospitals, sports villages and housing: an international approach to construction and engineering.

intro.title: An international construction and engineering company.
intro.body: NUMAN GROUPE designs and builds public facilities and residential developments. Our fields of work cover stadiums, hospitals, sports villages and housing.

process.title: From study to handover.
process.description: Four steps to frame, coordinate and deliver a facility — without promising a schedule or outcome we have not documented.

design.title: Design
design.body: Review of the brief, site constraints and operating needs, then a clear architectural and technical intent.

planning.title: Planning
planning.body: Organisation of packages, interfaces and checks. Any timetable remains a working hypothesis until the client confirms it.

build.title: Delivery on site
build.body: Site follow-up, trade coordination and safety requirements. Progress described in sample projects is fictional.

handover.title: Handover
handover.body: Preparation of reception, as-built files and the transfer of operations. No real commissioning is claimed here.

expertises.title: Projects that match your ambitions.
expertises.description: Fields of work that we expand as our projects develop.
expertises.empty: Expertise pages will be published soon.
expertises.scopePending: The detail of this expertise will be completed soon.
expertises.noProjects: No published project is linked to this expertise yet.
expertises.aboutTitle: Work framed by the brief and the contract
expertises.scopeByProject: Scope of work according to the project
expertises.closingLead: Tell us about the brief, the site and the intended contractual frame. We will come back to you to see whether a discussion is possible.

projects.title: From vision to delivery.
projects.description: A selection of planned, ongoing and completed projects.
projects.empty: The first projects will be published soon.
projects.sidebarInvite: Let’s talk about a similar project.

visits.title: Meetings and visits, presented for information.
visits.description: Visits to institutions, recorded as visits. They do not indicate a partnership, state support or the award of a contract.
visits.empty: No visits are published at the moment.
visits.disclaimer: A visit remains a visit: it is not an alliance, a commission or an endorsement.

team.title: Skills brought together around a shared ambition.
team.description: The leadership and teams who carry Numan Groupe International’s projects.
team.empty: The team presentation will be published soon.

group.lead: An international group founded in 1987 in Antalya, Republic of Türkiye. Project development, construction and infrastructure structuring, with cooperation focused on Africa, Asia and Europe.
group.sectorsLead: Fields in which the Group may take part, depending on the project and the skills required — not a list of completed works.

institutional.title: Institutional and administrative buildings
institutional.body: Administrative buildings, institutional headquarters, government complexes and other public buildings: brief, preliminary studies, coordination and follow-up, as the project requires.

health.title: Hospital and healthcare facilities
health.body: Hospitals, health centres and medico-social establishments. Preparation must take account of functional, sanitary, equipment and operating requirements.

sports.title: Sports facilities
sports.body: Stadiums, sports complexes, halls, training centres and competition venues: capacity, safety, accessibility, operations and maintenance.

roads.title: Roads and transport infrastructure
roads.body: Roads, engineering structures, traffic works and mobility equipment. Studies must include land, environmental and maintenance constraints.

ports.title: Ports and logistics platforms
ports.body: Port infrastructure, terminals, storage, handling and logistics platforms, with analysis of flows and applicable rules.

defense.title: Strategic and defence infrastructure
defense.body: Subject to applicable laws, authorisations and confidentiality rules, review of projects for public institutions and competent bodies.

urban.title: Urban development and territorial projects
urban.body: Residential areas, public facilities, local networks and integrated urban operations, taking planning and long-term operations into account.

group.financeCaveat: No financing solution can be treated as secured before the necessary checks, the agreement of the parties concerned and the signature of the applicable contractual and financial documents.

need.title: Needs and scope analysis
need.body: Definition of objectives and scope, and a preliminary analysis of needs.

prep.title: Technical and financial preparation
prep.body: Initial cost estimate, technical and financial proposal, indicative timetable.

risk.title: Risk and preliminary cost review
risk.body: Identification of risks, constraints and assumptions to be documented.

partners.title: Search for technical and financial partners
partners.body: Identifying needs for equity, debt or institutional financing, and seeking partners.

contract.title: Coordination before contracting
contract.body: Exchanges between authorities, companies and financiers, and follow-up of conditions precedent.

qualify.title: Qualifying the opportunity
qualify.body: Identifying the owner, the need, the site, the sector and the institutional framework.

collect.title: Reviewing information
collect.body: Available documents, existing studies, authorisations and main constraints.

analyse.title: Preliminary analysis
analyse.body: Technical, economic, legal, environmental and operational aspects.

define.title: Defining the solution
define.body: Programme, scope of intervention and a tailored proposal.

structure.title: Contractual and financial structuring
structure.body: Responsibilities, costs, guarantees, payment terms and financing mechanisms.

deliver.title: Delivery and coordination
deliver.body: Execution, coordination and follow-up in line with the contractual documents.

close.title: Control and close-out
close.body: Deliverables, reception, treatment of reservations and archiving.

rigour.title: Rigour
rigour.body: Decisions and proposals based on verifiable information, documented analysis and identified assumptions. Stated needs are examined before any offer.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Responsibilities, costs, time, risks and conditions presented clearly, with their limits and conditions precedent.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.body: Review against laws, regulations, standards, authorisations and contractual obligations. Confidentiality of information received.

responsibility.title: Responsibility
responsibility.body: The scope of commitments is defined clearly. Results that depend on external approvals are not presented as secured.

cooperation.title: Cooperation
cooperation.body: Structured coordination between authorities, companies, consultants, investors and financial institutions, according to agreed responsibilities.

continuity.title: Long-term continuity
continuity.body: Account is taken of operating and maintenance costs and of the ability to keep the service running.

group.closingTitle: A partner for preparing and delivering infrastructure projects.
group.closingBody: Numan Groupe International seeks professional relationships based on verifiable commitments, clearly defined responsibilities and delivery that meets applicable requirements.
